Maya (People Ops): Quick coordination for Devin's Tue morning onboarding — I-9 mobile notary booked 9:30am at HQ lobby. Please read below and react.

Devin (New Hire): Thanks! Flying in, ETA 8:45am. I'll head straight to lobby. :wave: 

Lina (IT): Laptop image 'redwood-std-2026' is provisioned. I'll drop device in locker #3 (code on calendar invite).

Mark (Facilities): I'll meet them at the entrance and escort to desk. Locker code will be taped. :thumbsup:

Carlos (Hiring Ops): Background check showed a small address mismatch. Devin, can you bring current DL + passport?

Devin (New Hire): Yep. DL has current address, passport has old one — will bring both.

Maya (People Ops): That's OK — mobile notary can complete I-9 with those. If mobile notary can't verify, fallback is campus kiosk at 3:00pm. Please RSVP here if that changes.

peopleops-bot: Reminder: submit benefits forms by EOD Mon — https://redwood/benefits/newhire (auto-reminder set).

Lina (IT): Sending SSO invite again now. Devin, check personal email and spam.

Devin (New Hire): got the invite, accepted. SSO ok.

Anya (Eng): Happy to be buddy — I'll do a 30-min intro at 11:00 and show infra basics. :coffee: 

Maya (People Ops): Lunch is on — we confirmed veg and GF options. Any dietary notes, Devin?

Devin (New Hire): I'm vegetarian, thanks!

Carlos (Hiring Ops): Quick ops note — laptop courier pickup scheduled Tue 5pm if remote. For in-office, bring device to IT desk at noon for inventory.

Lina (IT): Leave a sticky on the locker with employee name. I'll update asset tracker: `ASSET-2026-0421`.

Maya (People Ops): Calendar invites sent: I-9 @9:30, desk intro @10:00, buddy @11:00, lunch @12:00. If anyone needs to swap times, ping here.

Mark (Facilities): Security pass pre-approved, will hand over at lobby. Photo ID required.

Devin (New Hire): thanks all! See you Tuesday.

Maya (People Ops): :sparkles: All set. Closing thread unless anything else pops up.
